author: Corridor Crew
description:
They even built a system to have refraction levels on demand?!

Joe Letteri, Senior VFX Supervisor at Weta FX, breaks down some of the VFX processes that made the Avatar movies the masterpieces they are. 

Did you notice any inconsistencies in the water's refraction in the Avatar movies that could be explained by compositional differences?
title: CGI water refraction ON DEMAND?
